source.quote: ## 8. The physical interface and timing are essential

source_excerpts.text:
## 8. The physical interface and timing are essential

**The reduced generator alone does not guarantee the receiver resource.**

A random-unitary source channel

\[
\mathcal N(\rho)=\sum_w p_wU_w\rho U_w^\dagger
\]

can be implemented with a mixed classical selector controlling \(U_w\). That selector’s outgoing state is independent of the input and has zero communication capacity. The complete pure complement includes coherences involving its purification, which that implementation need not deliver.

The theorem requires the coherent pure output. Measuring the jump record first can destroy the resource used by the decoder.

The manuscript therefore includes an exact finite realization:

\[
\mathcal N_{r,\theta}
=
\mathcal D_r\circ\operatorname{Ad}_{e^{-i\theta X/2}}\circ\mathcal D_r,
\]

using two fresh pure bath qubits, two source–bath collisions, and an intervening source rotation. Bob receives the two bath qubits; the source is discarded.

It also separates physical timing conventions. If each collision and the drive lasts \(\tau\), with fixed bounded Hamiltonians, then

\[
r=\sin^2(g_0\tau),
\qquad
\theta=\Omega\tau,
\]

and the matched rate is

\[
\Theta\!\left(\tau^4\log(1/\tau)\right)
\]

per complete attempt of source-interaction duration \(3\tau\).

That quartic law belongs to this finite bounded-Hamiltonian model. The cubic law belongs to the effective Markov semigroup parameter. Reset, bath delivery, local processing, measurements and classical latency must be added in either case.

The transverse-dephasing geometry itself is an established physical model, including in quantum metrology. The result here concerns its complementary communication rate and its attained protocol. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.3286?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 9. Evidence, scope and preserved work

The accompanying programs check exact parity and concentration identities, complex witness/filter calculations, Choi-transposition conventions, actual integrated temporal filters in dimensions \(2,3,4\), and the streaming Kraus map on every basis string for small blocks. The exact qubit resource calculations use 70-digit arithmetic.

The largest recorded complex witness/filter discrepancy was below \(4\times10^{-15}\). These checks target implementation errors; the proofs supply the universal statements.

The result establishes an operational rate classification and a finite construction. It does not determine optimal leading constants, general finite-time numerical capacity, unassisted capacity, a private-capacity trichotomy, or hardware fault tolerance. The general code constants can be conservative. Logarithmic memory still has to remain coherent through long source-attempt sequences.

The complete deliverables are:

[Astra_P1_Markov_Bath_Onset.pdf](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_871df5db3e3881918cea064aa569f690&account_id=personal)

The 37-page manuscript contains the theorem, full proofs, finite constructions, source comparisons and resource accounting.

[Astra_P1_Markov_Bath_Onset_Package.zip](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_c3aef8278a3c8191b6812529e046a4d4&account_id=personal)

The package contains the manuscript source, verification programs and results, detailed construction handoff, and the **unchanged finite-memory profile-dilution archive**.

That preserved archive retains the finite-memory normal form, sharp recovery exponent, direct full-rank construction, monogamy converse and explicit qutrit communication protocol. Its conventions remain intact: chosen-receiver Bell preparation costs \(\Theta(k)\) attempts and \(O(k^2)\) full-emitter operations; offline preparation does not remove the \(p_k^n\) cost for an existing unknown block; and fixed internal dimension supplies neither fixed coherence time nor fault tolerance.

source_excerpts.text:
## 2. What this establishes beyond ordinary routing and entanglement processing

The consequential claim is the **matched operational law for an entire class of physical dynamics**.

Given the exact finite generator and the stipulated coherent interface, one can now:

1. Determine whether the environment can transmit quantum information.
2. Determine the optimal short-time order, including the logarithmic factor.
3. Acquire a finite receiver instrument exposing the useful quantum component.
4. Construct Bell-pair distribution and subsequent transmission of fresh unknown payloads.
5. Account for failed attempts, memory, coherent waiting, decoding, precision and code acquisition.

The upper bounds already allow arbitrary block encodings, adaptive feedback, entanglement concentration and error correction. They are comparisons against the strongest protocols under the same interface.

A direct swap, delivery of the surviving source system, or a separate erasure link changes that interface. Those may be better engineering choices where available. The theorem concerns a fixed source whose environmental output is the available communication link.

Several ingredients are established. Leung and Watrous already proved positive unassisted complementary capacity for nontrivial qubit depolarizing channels and extended their argument to relevant Pauli channels. Siddhu developed entropy-singularity methods giving broader complementary-capacity positivity results. Thus neither complementary-channel positivity nor the appearance of a logarithmic entropy term is the new claim. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/1510.01366v4?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The proposed advance is the **universal zero/linear/cubic-log classification, with matching adaptive converses and acquired constructions**. Established entanglement protocols remain the machinery that completes transmission.
